states.name: Dead
states.behavior: 不可用基础格；不接受邻消扣层

states.name: Open
states.behavior: 普通承载格；按堆顶参与排序/消除

states.name: RV
states.behavior: 广告/金币解锁；不由邻消打开

states.name: Cost
states.behavior: 全盘按消除块数扣Cost

states.name: Wood
states.behavior: 相邻事件扣1，归零Open并计目标

states.name: Ice
states.behavior: 相邻事件扣1，解冰保留原堆

states.name: Hole
states.behavior: 无活动状态处理器；旧排序器仍有同色Hole优先分支

states.name: Grass
states.behavior: 本格消除扣1；不是邻消扣层

states.name: Camera
states.behavior: 邻消拍照；目标完成停止普通收集，道具入口独立

states.name: LockHighRise
states.behavior: 全局累计消除量达到固定Cost门槛

states.name: FridgeCan
states.behavior: 仅保留罐子表现，未接通棋盘消除处理

states.name: BirdHouse
states.behavior: 本版工厂默认null，无活动处理器

states.name: WaitingCell
states.behavior: 被开的位置；按完整NextState恢复

states.name: WaitingCellStack
states.behavior: 按累计量确定数量，权重抽位置；发完变Dead

states.name: FireCracker
states.behavior: 邻消发射；全盘优先级目标、在途排斥

states.name: Toaster
states.behavior: 两阶段相位；每个产出阶段收2片

states.name: Gramophone
states.behavior: 本版工厂默认null，无活动处理器

states.name: ColorNuts
states.behavior: 旧类型停用；不能套用33

states.name: CarParking
states.behavior: 沿固定车道逐格移动Car，入位提交目标

states.name: Curtain
states.behavior: 全盘匹配色按块数扣；揭幕后提升后继

states.name: Cloud
states.behavior: 旧类型停用；不能套用46

states.name: Playpen
states.behavior: 邻消颜色匹配剩余球色，移除对应球

states.name: GemBox
states.behavior: 相邻命中排队投宝石；无合适空间直接收

states.name: Gem
states.behavior: 邻消一次收集，提升完整后继

states.name: Honey
states.behavior: 邻消一次投1滴；全盘选目标，无目标仍扣存量

states.name: HoneyTrap
states.behavior: 邻消解黏，保留原堆

states.name: SnakeBody
states.behavior: 同组轮廓邻接触发各节；不是只通知最近节

states.name: SnakeTail
states.behavior: 同组链形与尾部收集、计分

states.name: BirdNest
states.behavior: Cost每次减1，新Cost偶数时收1只

states.name: Pearl
states.behavior: 匹配当前珍珠色；目标结束前可持续产珍珠

states.name: Doll
states.behavior: 待处理批次扣1；空邻格随机迁移或原地打开

states.name: Drone
states.behavior: 两相位递送表现块，不增加普通可排序颜色堆

states.name: DronePad
states.behavior: 同ID停靠点，按Cost选择下一站

states.name: DroneHandler
states.behavior: 控制同组转移，最终退出才收Drone目标

states.name: GeneratorNuts
states.behavior: 匹配当前坚果，完整色段与补充队列

states.name: RainbowLauncher
states.behavior: 激活/发射两阶段；候选评分选择目标和颜色

states.name: Jelly
states.behavior: 按方向和片状态扣除，保存旋转及片数组

states.name: SeedBox
states.behavior: 全盘播草，也可把草写到机关NextState

states.name: CupboardPrimary
states.behavior: 柜门开启后转移杯子；与副半共用邻接去重

states.name: CupboardSecondary
states.behavior: 与主半配对，不能人工重复扣一次

states.name: Bloom
states.behavior: 汇集同轮颜色，同色双击与后续匹配分支不同

states.name: Safe
states.behavior: 按块数转动，收金完成才开；道具计量独立

states.name: BoxingGlove
states.behavior: 两相位拳套；邻格优先目标，待击队列

states.name: Kettle
states.behavior: 按目标额度生成云，预占坐标并保存原堆

states.name: Steam
states.behavior: 邻消收云，动画后恢复原堆顺序

states.name: Dice
states.behavior: 掷1至6点，队列和共享剩余目标防超收

states.name: Mole
states.behavior: 同ID洞口按SequenceID循环或随机；出现延迟可击

states.name: PopcornMaker
states.behavior: 全盘按块数扣；爆开播撒爆米花

states.name: Popcorn
states.behavior: 邻消收集，提升后继

states.name: CandyMachine
states.behavior: 命中相位控制同ID糖果收集，最后清机器

states.name: Candy
states.behavior: 将邻消转发给注册机器；远处候选优先消费

states.name: Drill
states.behavior: 两相位钻头；攻击后可迁入清空目标

states.name: SoilBomb
states.behavior: 同ID组预锁，邻接链传播；置0防重复爆炸

states.name: TeslaTower
states.behavior: 充放电相位；灯泡组和待处理队列

states.name: TeslaBulb
states.behavior: 由塔选择，预置Cost0防重复再动画开格

states.name: Rabbit
states.behavior: 按ID与SequenceID转移，落地才激活下一站

states.name: Penguin
states.behavior: 解冻后固定方向逐格移动，无绕路

states.name: Igloo
states.behavior: 按ID收企鹅，收完停用而非一律Open

states.name: HexGenerator
states.behavior: 朝向固定输出位；输出空且解锁后才消耗生成次数

states.name: FireCrackerGenerator
states.behavior: Cost5至1充能，批量火箭可重复分配同一目标
